targets.expr: {app="tuclaw", component="daemon", component=~"$component"} |= `$search` | json | line_format "⛓ DAEMON | {{.level | ToUpper}} | [{{.component}}] {{.msg}}{{if .chat_id}} chat={{.chat_id}}{{end}}{{if .topic_id}} topic={{.topic_id}}{{end}}{{if .context}} ctx={{.context}}{{end}}{{if .duration}} duration={{.duration}}{{end}}{{if .container_action}} action={{.container_action}}{{end}}{{if .error}} error={{.error}}{{end}}"

{app="tuclaw", component="agent", component=~"$component"} |= `$search` |~ "^\\{" | json | line_format "✨ AGENT  | {{.level | ToUpper}} | [{{.msg}}]{{if .tool}} tool={{.tool}}{{end}}{{if .tool_id}} id={{.tool_id}}{{end}}{{if .content_len}} len={{.content_len}}{{end}}{{if .error}} error={{.error}}{{end}}"

{app="tuclaw", component=~"$component"} |~ "^\\{" | json | level=~"ERROR|WARN" | line_format "{{.level | ToUpper}} [{{.component}}] {{.msg}}{{if .error}} error={{.error}}{{end}}{{if .chat_id}} chat={{.chat_id}}{{end}}{{if .context}} ctx={{.context}}{{end}}"

panels.description: Limit-weighted tokens over the dashboard range: in + 5*out + 2*cache_write_1h + 1.25*other_writes. Cache reads excluded - overnight calibration showed they are ~free for subscription limits. ~1.5M = 1% of the weekly window. Note: increase() slightly undercounts when a new context/kind label combo is born mid-range.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(tuclaw_anthropic_input_tokens_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + 5*(sum(increase(tuclaw_anthropic_output_tokens_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + 2*(sum(increase(tuclaw_anthropic_cache_creation_tokens_total{ttl="1h"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + 1.25*(sum(increase(tuclaw_anthropic_cache_creation_tokens_total{ttl!="1h"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.description: One row per completed agent turn (daemon 'turn' wide event). 7d % (est) = the turn's estimated share of the WEEKLY subscription window from its own tokens: (in + 5*out + 2*cache_write) / 1.5M = 1%. Calibrated 2026-07-12 on the clean dream night: SDK-true night spend 1.8M matched the observed +1pp weekly move (earlier 500k figure undercounted the wire - increase() misses series born mid-window at full value). Accuracy ~+/-40%; refined as clean nights accumulate. Red = a single turn ate ~2% of the week. Cache write = newly written context; Ctx % = window fill after the turn.
